metadata.user_request: make a simple EMA crossover strategy that uses 30 and 70 periods crossing each other for entry. Open long positions when 30 ema crosses above 70 ema and enter short position when 70 ema crosses below 30 ema. The stop loss should be set 15 pips from entry and take profit should be 70 pips from entry

items.title: Implement Complete EMA Crossover Strategy
items.description: Implement complete trading strategy with: (1) Data loading from CSV/API with OHLCV validation, (2) EMA indicator calculation (30-period and 70-period), (3) Entry conditions: Long position when 30 EMA crosses above 70 EMA, Short position when 30 EMA crosses below 70 EMA, (4) Exit conditions: 15 pips stop loss and 70 pips take profit from the entry price, (5) Complete backtest runner with SimBroker adapter. Include explicit loop termination (e.g., max_iterations), robust error handling, and comprehensive logging for all trade lifecycle events. The strategy must be production-ready and fully testable.
